sam: Heads up — customer's Python sample treats 502 as fatal while Go retries. We lack a consistent error surface across SDKs.
rita: Ugh, seen that. Can we define a tiny canonical envelope and make SDKs normalize into it?
owen: Sketch: {kind, code, http_status, retryable, retry_after_seconds?, message}. SDKs expose typed exception/object.
marc: Streaming needs special treatment: StreamingInterrupted kind + last_event_index.
sam: Action: write spec PR with http->retry mapping (429 retryable honor Retry-After; 503/500/502 retryable; 4xx except 429 not retryable), add short sample apps (py/go/js) asserting parity, and gate behind feature flag.
ci-bot: Note: added 'cross-sdk error normalization' to devex agenda (Tue 10:00).
sam: I'll open tracking ticket and assign owners.
